lines.text: Hiram king of Tyre sends envoys, cedar logs, stonemasons, and carpenters to build David a temple, and David sees the LORD has established him.
In Jerusalem David takes more wives, and more sons and daughters are born to him, including Solomon.
When the Philistines search for David and raid the Valley of Rephaim, he inquires of God, and the LORD promises to deliver them.
David defeats the Philistines at Baal-perazim, where they abandon their gods, and David orders them buried in the valley.
When the Philistines raid again, David follows God's plan by the balsam trees, strikes them from Gibeon to Gezer, and his fame spreads.
